style: cute blocky meadow: ink #3b2614, honey #ffd23f, cream #fff3d8, meadow greens; cast = blocky GLB renders with an ink outline
coords: rect = [x, y, w, h] in px from top-left of the backdrop at its native size; norm = same divided by width/height (0-1). Points = [x, y].
buttons: title buttons assets/ui/screens/btn-{challenge,relaxed}-{idle,pressed}.png are 520x168 and the button slots are 520x168, so they draw 1:1 on the native backdrop.

title-portrait.safeArea: Designed for 1080x1920 (9:16). Scale with object-fit: cover, anchored centre. Taller phones (19.5:9, e.g. 1080x2340 / 390x844) crop about 7% from each side, so every slot keeps >= 90 px (8%) side margin. Keep UI out of the top 120 px (notch/status bar) and bottom 90 px (home indicator); all slots already do. Compute slot positions from the normalized rects on the displayed (cover-scaled) image.
title-portrait.notes: logo rect matches logo.png aspect (1600x600 = 2.667). Buttons 1:1.

title-landscape.safeArea: Designed for 1920x1080 (16:9). Scale with object-fit: cover, anchored centre. Wider phones (19.5:9) crop about 9% from top and bottom, so slots keep >= 60 px top/bottom margin and stay in the central 80%. Keep UI clear of the left/right 100 px (notch / rounded corners in landscape). Compute slot positions from the normalized rects on the displayed (cover-scaled) image.
title-landscape.notes: logo rect matches logo.png aspect (1600x600 = 2.667). Buttons 1:1.

results-portrait.notes: rank-N rect = where badge assets/ui/screens/rank-N.png (256x256) goes, scaled to the rect, sitting on the front face of its podium step. stand-N = top-centre of step N, where that player's critter stands (feet). Order left to right: 4th, 2nd, 1st (tallest, centred), 3rd. panel = calm cream area for scores / a Continue button (optional).

track.note: cream pill with ink outline and a recessed groove; draw at the progress-bar slot

fill.note: mint #7dffb0 (amber #ffb347 alt, e.g. for slow/retry) pill with ink edge and gloss. Place at track inner rect; show progress p by drawing width = max(52, p*672) with 9-slice caps of 26 px left/right (or clip with a rounded rect). Hide fill at p=0.

capGlow.note: centre on the fill's right end: x = trackX + 24 + fillWidth - 26, y = trackY + 48. Pulse scale 0.9-1.1, additive or normal blend.

og.note: logo baked in; og-image.jpg is the same image, smaller for platforms that prefer JPEG

brand.maskableSafeZone: bee kept inside the central 80% circle (r = 204.8 px at 512); background is full-bleed
